change_log: 0.2.1 (29 Oct): no teaching rule changed. (1) The existing D3.1 rules of 0.2.0 are written below as checkable rules, because the D3.1 audit found the checker ignored most of them. (2) The page wording that render_tile.py hard-coded is moved here. (3) D3.1 is split into sub-tiles by physics idea for coverage only: every sub-tile uses the same D3.1 rules.
owner_rules: if not worth to update blueprint, i.e, specific, then they are Topic adapters (29 Oct)

D3.1.rule: D3.1.k uses the D3.1 rules unchanged; k names the physics idea that its library items and questions share. A sub-tile adds a blueprint rule only when no D3.1 rule can express a teaching or try operation that other Physics topics would also need. Physics facts go to the library; topic situations and pictures go to the topic adapter by reference.
